name: Create a new CNI object
description: Create a new CNI object Creates a new Cloud Network Interconnect (CNI) for private network connectivity between Cloudflare and your infrastructure. POST /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/cni/cnis
context:
POST /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/cni/cnis
Creates a new Cloud Network Interconnect (CNI) for private network connectivity between Cloudflare and your infrastructure. CNIs enable dedicated, high-performance network links.
Required: account_id (path); body (body)

name: Create a new interconnect
description: Create a new interconnect Creates a new network interconnect for connecting Cloudflare's network to external networks. POST /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/cni/interconnects
context:
POST /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/cni/interconnects
Creates a new network interconnect for connecting Cloudflare's network to external networks. Interconnects provide dedicated bandwidth and reduced latency for traffic exchange.
Required: account_id (path); body (body)

name: Delete a specified CNI object
description: Delete a specified CNI object Permanently removes a Cloud Network Interconnect (CNI) configuration. DELETE /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/cni/cnis/{cni}

name: Delete an interconnect object
description: Delete an interconnect object Permanently removes a network interconnect configuration. DELETE /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/cni/interconnects/{icon}

name: Get information about a CNI object
description: Get information about a CNI object Retrieves configuration details for a specific Cloud Network Interconnect (CNI), including connection status and parameters. GET /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/cni/cnis/{cni}

name: Get information about an interconnect object
description: Get information about an interconnect object Retrieves configuration and status details for a specific network interconnect. GET /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/cni/interconnects/{icon}

name: Generate the Letter of Authorization (LOA) for a given interconnect
description: Generate the Letter of Authorization (LOA) for a given interconnect Downloads the Letter of Authorization (LOA) for a network interconnect, required for physical cross-connect provisioning. GET /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/cni/interconnects/{icon}/loa
context:
GET /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/cni/interconnects/{icon}/loa
Downloads the Letter of Authorization (LOA) for a network interconnect, required for physical cross-connect provisioning.
Required: icon (path) — Interconnect name to retrieve information about; account_id (path)
Optional: name (query) — Custom name to use in the LOA instead of the account name (200 Character limit)

name: Get the default customer name for LOA generation
description: Get the default customer name for LOA generation Retrieves the default customer name that will be used in the LOA if no name is provided to the `/accounts/{account_id}/cni/interconnects/{icon}/loa` endpoint. GET /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/cni/interconnects/{icon}/loa/default
context:
GET /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/cni/interconnects/{icon}/loa/default
Retrieves the default customer name that will be used in the LOA if no name is provided to the `/accounts/{account_id}/cni/interconnects/{icon}/loa` endpoint.
Required: icon (path) — Interconnect name to retrieve information about; account_id (path)

name: Get the current status of an interconnect object
description: Get the current status of an interconnect object Gets the current operational status of a network interconnect, including link state and traffic metrics. GET /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/cni/interconnects/{icon}/status
context:
GET /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/cni/interconnects/{icon}/status
Gets the current operational status of a network interconnect, including link state and traffic metrics.
Required: icon (path) — Interconnect name to retrieve information about; account_id (path)

name: Get the current settings for the active account
description: Get the current settings for the active account Retrieves current settings configuration for the specified resource or service. GET /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/cni/settings
context:
GET /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/cni/settings
Retrieves current settings configuration for the specified resource or service.
Required: account_id (path) — Account tag to retrieve settings for

name: Get information about the specified slot
description: Get information about the specified slot Gets information about a specific infrastructure slot allocation. GET /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/cni/slots/{slot}

name: List existing CNI objects
description: List existing CNI objects Lists all Cloud Network Interconnects (CNIs) configured for the account, showing connection status and parameters. GET /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/cni/cnis
context:
GET /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/cni/cnis
Lists all Cloud Network Interconnects (CNIs) configured for the account, showing connection status and parameters.
Required: account_id (path)
Optional: slot (query) — If specified, only show CNIs associated with the specified slot; tunnel_id (query) — If specified, only show cnis associated with the specified tunnel id; cursor (query); limit (query)

name: List existing interconnects
description: List existing interconnects Lists all network interconnects configured for the account, including physical and virtual connections. GET /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/cni/interconnects
context:
GET /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/cni/interconnects
Lists all network interconnects configured for the account, including physical and virtual connections.
Required: account_id (path)
Optional: site (query) — If specified, only show interconnects located at the given site; type (query) — If specified, only show interconnects of the given type; cursor (query); limit (query)

name: Retrieve a list of all slots matching the specified parameters
description: Retrieve a list of all slots matching the specified parameters Lists all available infrastructure slots for the account, showing allocation status and capacity. GET /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/cni/slots
context:
GET /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/cni/slots
Lists all available infrastructure slots for the account, showing allocation status and capacity.
Required: account_id (path)
Optional: address_contains (query) — If specified, only show slots with the given text in their address field; site (query) — If specified, only show slots located at the given site; speed (query) — If specified, only show slots that support the given speed; occupied (query) — If specified, only show slots with a specific occupied/unoccupied state; cursor (query); limit (query)

name: Modify stored information about a CNI object
description: Modify stored information about a CNI object Updates the configuration of an existing Cloud Network Interconnect (CNI), including connection parameters and routing settings. PUT /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/cni/cnis/{cni}

name: Update the current settings for the active account
description: Update the current settings for the active account Updates configuration settings for the specified resource or service. PUT /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/cni/settings
context:
PUT /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/cni/settings
Updates configuration settings for the specified resource or service.
Required: account_id (path) — Account tag to update settings for; body (body)
